note: NewsBreak test of the RollerAds sweeps offers (owner, 19.11.2026: «тест оферов на новом источнике по минималкам ставки, бюджет максимально ограничен по деньгам, все на паузе»). Limits found on the platform 19.11: CPC bid at least $0.10 (9 cents answers «illegal bid rate too small»); an ad set with a DAILY budget needs at least $10 (1000 cents); a TOTAL budget needs at least $10 for every calendar day of the flight ($20 for a one day flight that crosses midnight, $80 for seven days); the headline is 90 characters at most; the image of a native ad is best 16:9.
